description: GTEx median TPM of RPL36A vs RPL36AL across all tissues, with per-tissue ratio
code:
import requests, json
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def gid(sym):
    g=requests.get("https://gtexportal.org/api/v2/reference/gene",
                   params={"geneId":sym,"itemsPerPage":20},timeout=120).json()
    return [d for d in g["data"] if d["geneSymbol"].upper()==sym.upper()][0]["gencodeId"]

gA,gB=gid("RPL36A"),gid("RPL36AL"); print(gA,gB)
res={}
for ds in ["gtex_v8","gtex_v10"]:
    e=requests.get("https://gtexportal.org/api/v2/expression/medianGeneExpression",
                   params={"gencodeId":[gA,gB],"datasetId":ds,"itemsPerPage":200},timeout=180).json()
    res[ds]=len(e.get("data",[]))
    if e.get("data"): sample=e["data"][0]
print("rows per dataset:",res); print("sample row:",json.dumps(sample,indent=1))

ds="gtex_v8" if res["gtex_v8"] else "gtex_v10"
e=requests.get("https://gtexportal.org/api/v2/expression/medianGeneExpression",
               params={"gencodeId":[gA,gB],"datasetId":ds,"itemsPerPage":200},timeout=180).json()
d=pd.DataFrame(e["data"])
piv=d.pivot_table(index="tissueSiteDetailId",columns="geneSymbol",values="median")
piv["log2_A_over_AL"]=np.log2(piv.RPL36A/piv.RPL36AL)
piv=piv.sort_values("log2_A_over_AL")
print(f"\n--- {ds} median TPM, {len(piv)} tissues ---")
print(piv.round(2).to_string())
piv.round(3).to_csv("gtex_RPL36A_vs_RPL36AL_median_tpm.csv")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(15,10))
y=np.arange(len(piv))
ax[0].barh(y-0.2,piv.RPL36A,height=0.4,color="#2b6cb0",label="RPL36A")
ax[0].barh(y+0.2,piv.RPL36AL,height=0.4,color="#d69e2e",label="RPL36AL")
ax[0].set_yticks(y); ax[0].set_yticklabels(piv.index,fontsize=6); ax[0].invert_yaxis()
ax[0].set_xlabel(f"GTEx {ds} median TPM"); ax[0].legend(frameon=False)
ax[0].set_title("RPL36A and RPL36AL are both expressed in every GTEx tissue")
ax[1].barh(y,piv.log2_A_over_AL,color="#4a5568"); ax[1].axvline(0,color="k",lw=1)
ax[1].set_yticks(y); ax[1].set_yticklabels([]); ax[1].invert_yaxis()
ax[1].set_xlabel("log2(RPL36A / RPL36AL)")
ax[1].set_title("Ratio varies ~%.1f-fold across tissues"%(2**(piv.log2_A_over_AL.max()-piv.log2_A_over_AL.min())))
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print("\nlog2 ratio median %.2f  min %.2f (%s)  max %.2f (%s)"%(
  piv.log2_A_over_AL.median(),piv.log2_A_over_AL.min(),piv.index[0],
  piv.log2_A_over_AL.max(),piv.index[-1]))
